title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Quest Objective: The Waking Moon Festival is drawing near in the Land of Xuanfang, yet rumors that "the Hold is doomed to fall" have begun to spread throughout the city. To find the Sentinel who has long been absent, you decide to head to where Hsin's presence was last felt—the Manifold Sanctum.

Unknown Sender: [Xianling Village Farmhouse] Grand Opening Special: half-price on everything! Be the first to taste our Waking Moon Feast. Even the Golden-Eyed One swears by it! Reply "Unsub" to unsubscribe.
[Choice]  But I haven't tried it yet.
(Rover): But I haven't tried it yet.
Unknown Sender: Shoot, did this actually go to Rover's Terminal...?
[Choice]  Unsub.
(Rover): Unsub.
Unknown Sender: Don't go, valued patron! This text reaching you must be fate. Come give us a try! You won't regret it!
[Choice]  ?

subsection: Listen to the rumors at the tea stall
content:
[Objective: Listen to the rumors at the tea stall]
Hesitant Voice: So you're really set on moving to Mengzhou?
Hushed Voice: Of course! Once the Censure Courts clear out the last of the Tacet Discords, Xuanfang Hold will have served its purpose and collapse. We've known that since day one, haven't we?
Hesitant Voice: It can't just crumble overnight, though. The Ministry of War would give notice first, wouldn't they?
Hushed Voice: Oh, please... Think about all the strange things that've been happening. Sit around waiting for an official notice, and you'll be caught with your trousers down.
Hushed Voice: And with the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs sending people now... something big's brewing. You can count on it...
Hushed Voice: Anyway, better to be ahead of the curve than buried under it. When things go sideways, who knows what else might happen...
Hesitant Voice: That's... kind of jumping at shadows, isn't it?
Hushed Voice: Ugh, you never see past your own nose. Forget it. Eat up, eat up.
Rover: (Xuanfang Hold collapsing... at a time like this? And the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...)
Rover: (I remember their reach extends all across Huanglong... If they're showing up now, it must involve Hsin in some way.)
Tangning: (Oh... ran straight into  the second I stepped out.)
Tangning: (Given my position, I really ought to speak with , but—)
Tangning: (Better see Intendant Suoming first. Safer to let her decide how to approach the Arbiter.)

content:
[Objective: Talk to Shuyun]
Shuyun: Tangning? Well, look at you. All dressed up.
Tangning: Dressed up? Feels like a plain old work uniform to me.
Shuyun: You? Work? I only ever see you loafing about the Hold, teasing birds, sipping tea, gabbing with anyone who listen.
Tangning: Ouch. You make me sound useless... even if you're not wrong. Anyway, I'm off. Gotta go see the boss.
Tangning: To be honest, I'm a little nervous. Heard she once ousted the local officials back home and took over herself...
Shuyun: Is this job of yours above board? Sounds like you work for a tyrant.
Tangning: I just worry we won't see eye to eye. That what matters to me... might mean nothing to her.
Shuyun: What's with the doom and gloom? You'll be fine, I know it.
Shuyun: Remember that rogue Autopuppet that smashed into my house? You took it down with a yawn while fixing your hair.
Tangning: I had no idea I was that good. And are you telling me to pick a fight with her...?
Shuyun: Haha. Tell you what, I just made some Moon Fox Rice Cakes. Bring them along as a gift for your scary boss.
Tangning: Oh... thank you.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Talk to Jiqing]
Jiqing: You must be Tangning. Intendant Suoming is expecting you.
Jiqing: I am Jiqing. Thank you for your service. Ten years in the Hold is no small thing.
Tangning: It's nothing. But may I ask, do you have any insight into what she might be thinking?
Jiqing: What she's thinking? Meaning?
Tangning: I don't doubt the Intendant's competence. I'm sure she can handle whatever comes.
Tangning: But... she doesn't feel for Xuanfang Hold the way I do. And those rumors about her, two hundred years back...
Tangning: I'm afraid she'll sacrifice the Hold's best interests for the Ministry's ends.
Jiqing: Seems you're not very familiar with those rumors, or else I doubt you'd think that.
Tangning: I know that everyone who fought beside her back then were all—
Jiqing: Easy now. Speak with Intendant Suoming yourself. If you have concerns, voice them directly.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Meet with Intendant Suoming]
Tangning: (If the Intendant truly means to leave the Hold to its fate, then I'll have to...)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Suoming meets with Tangning]
Tangning: Intendant Suoming.
Suoming: Yes. Speak.
Tangning: Not long ago, my Providence Lock opened on its own. Following its guidance, I went in secret to the Manifold Sanctum and measured the Sentinel's frequency.
Tangning: There's no mistaking it. Her frequency is fading fast. I fear the Sanctum could fall at any moment.
Suoming: I see. Your years of reporting to the Ministry on all that has occurred here are duly noted.
Suoming: All of it, exactly as you foresaw a century ago.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: All of it, exactly as you foresaw a century ago.



Suoming: I understand your final charge. I will deliver it into "Hsin's" hands.
???: Forgive me. In the end, the promise went unkept.
Suoming: No matter. From the day we met, I have known you gave everything you had.
Suoming: And the promise is only deferred. A hundred years is nothing. Without you in Mengzhou, the Ministry will have much to do.
???: Then it all falls to you, Suoming.
Suoming: You needn't say that. This was all part of your design, wasn't it?
???: Not design. Only faith. Faith in you... and in Her.
Suoming: Today's the day, then...
Suoming: The Manifold Sanctum and Hsin the Moon Fox are one and the same. I must see the truth for myself before it falls.
Suoming: Only the three of us will go, lest we rouse the "snake." We should not draw attention.
Tangning: But—
Suoming: Tangning. I know this place holds your heart. Your concern is only natural.
Suoming: Hsin the Moon Fox accounted for this from the start. The Sanctum was built to break clean from the Hold.
Suoming: Should the worst happen and it falls, the surrounding districts will remain standing.
Suoming: And should the Hold itself be imperiled, don't look for me. Put the people first.
Tangning: I, Tangning, will see that it is done.
Suoming: One more thing. Ten years you've held this post. With Hsin here, I should've been the one overseeing Xuanfang myself.
Suoming: But Mengzhou's crises didn't let me go. You and your predecessors have held firm in your duty.
Suoming: For Hsin, for Mengzhou, you've done more than your share. You have my gratitude.
Tangning: Yes! Intendant Suoming, may all be well in  keeping.
Suoming: May all be well in Hsin's keeping.
Tangning: Ah, that reminds me. Xuanfang's Waking Moon Festival is almost here. The last few were a delight. Will you join us this time, Intendant?
Suoming: The Waking Moon Festival... If things go well, we'll see.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Meet with Qingxiao]
Girl: Take this! Xuanyuan First Form, Hidden Heart!
Boy: Master Qingxiao never taught us that move... Cheater!
Girl: The immortal lady told us, "We train in the heart, not in the form." I came up with this myself!
Qingxiao: Rover, you've come.
Children: Greetings, Senior !
[Dialogue Option]  Taking in disciples already, Master Sword Transcendent?
Qingxiao: ...Mm. In the old days, if I did not attend, Hsin would send a Rafter Kite to fetch me, hounding me till I went.
Boy: I wish we could meet Lady Hsin! Grandma and Grandpa always say the Sentinel will come to play with us at the festival, but we've never seen Her, not once.
Girl: Don't you know? That's just grown-up talk to make us behave. Like the one about Autopuppets stealing kids who won't go to bed...
Qingxiao: Hsin is... simply a little busy. You will have the chance to see Her some other day.
Qingxiao: Your mother's here. Off you go.
[Dialogue Option]  Everything all right?
Qingxiao: It's just... I'm still not quite used to minding such lively little ones.
Rover: Does it remind you of when you first met Ruoyun?
Qingxiao: No... Hsin.
Rover: ...?
Qingxiao: But let's return to the matter at hand.
Qingxiao: I asked you here, in part, to talk about Hsin. These past few days... the presence I have sensed from Her has grown weaker than before.
Qingxiao: Hsin keeps no set path, so a flickering presence is nothing new... She vanishes for a time, then reappears as if nothing happened, chattering of trifles.
Qingxiao: In the past, Hsin never spoke of what She was doing, so I asked no further.
Qingxiao: Yet with Xuanfang's portents growing more frequent, even the Rafter Kites no longer bring word of Her. Until moments ago, I sensed a wisp of Her presence near the Sanctum, but it was gone in a breath, too fleeting to catch.
Qingxiao: ...Hence my wish for you to accompany me to Xuanfang Hold to search for Her trail. And when the moment calls, I may need to rely on your power as Arbiter.
[Dialogue Option]  I understand.
Rover: Then let's head to the Hold first. There's something I've been wanting to look into as well.
Rover: Talk on the way?
Qingxiao: Thank you. After all this is settled...
[Dialogue Option]  You'll invite me to dinner?
[Dialogue Option]  You'll take me to the Waking Moon Festival?
Qingxiao: ...So be it.

[Dialogue Option]  What's all this about?



Qingchen: Well, a while back, someone from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs said the Hold had "served its purpose" and would collapse any day now. Told us to move out while we could.
Wanhong: Ridiculous. Our family has lived in this land for generations. You don't just pack up and leave...
Qingchen: To be fair, I'm not convinced either. It came out of nowhere...
Qingchen: But that person carried an Intendant's command token. Clearly no small figure... And I'd rather not wait to find out. We can't survive another disaster like the Autopuppet rebellion...
[Dialogue Option]  Nothing's settled yet. No need to panic.
Qingchen: If you say so, Rover, I want to believe it. But the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs...
[Dialogue Option]  Something does feel off...
Qingchen: See? Even Rover thinks the same thing!
Liangyu: Paragon Qingxiao, my apologies for disturbing your cultivation. But there's been an emergency... It requires your attention.
Qingxiao: It's no trouble. What's happened?
Liangyu: Someone tried to break into the Sanctum. We've detained her, but she claims to hold the Sentinel's token. Except... it's not in any of our records. No way to verify it.
Qingxiao: Token...
Qingxiao: Did she say where she came from?
Liangyu: She said... she's an Intendant in Mengzhou's Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Qingxiao: ...I see. Rover and I are bound for the Sanctum as we speak. We won't be long.

Qingxiao: Why the evasion?
Tangning: Forgive us. To us in the Ministry,  holds a special standing. Not something to speak of before outsiders.
Rover: Your Ministry governs Sentinel matters, so this is about...
Rover: Ah, I get it. Qingxiao already knows I'm the Arbiter. No need to dance around it.
Tangning: We meant no disrespect, Arbiter. The situation demanded immediate action. We couldn't report in time.
Tangning: Besides, the Intendant ordered us to stay silent. She said... you would surely arrive at the Sanctum at this time, and that all your questions would be answered there.
Jiqing: As for the panic this has caused, we'll help the Wardens contain it.

Suoming: And this... would be the Xuan Paragon. Qingxiao, I take it. A pleasure.
[Dialogue Option]  What's the situation?
Liangyu: She claims she came by decree to meet the Sentinel. And yes, we've confirmed that she really is an Intendant from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs.
Liangyu: But by custom, the Sentinel has to approve visitors first before an escort guides them in. And with Her absence of late, there's no way to know Her will.
Liangyu: Besides... if the Intendant truly came by decree, why sneak in through a side gate?
Qingxiao: The people on the way over here spoke of "Xuanfang Hold's collapse." Did that rumor come from you?
Suoming: Yes.
Suoming: The Ministry detected that Hsin's frequency has become critically unstable, reaching its breaking point. As Her state and the Hold's are one, I acted to keep the people safe.
Rover: You're only just noticing this now?
Suoming: Spare the probing questions. The Ministry's decisions and orders are not mine to disclose, Arbiter.
Suoming: Hsin's ... I never imagined She would give this to you.
[Dialogue Option]  ...What's that supposed to mean?
Suoming: It means... She had a change of heart. She chose to trust you.
Suoming: Paragon Qingxiao. You know Hsin the Moon Fox well. You understand what this token signifies.
Qingxiao: That's... a Vermillion Lock...
Suoming: It is a covenant. A deal between Hsin the Moon Fox and me. The time has come for Her to honor it. But as things stand, She may not even be able to save Herself.
Suoming: We don't have much time.
Liangyu: Paragon, what does all this mean...?
Qingxiao: It is Hsin's frequency within that lock. She speaks the truth.
[Dialogue Option]  So that presence you sensed earlier...
Qingxiao: Came from this, yes.
Suoming: Is that proof enough for you?
Qingxiao: Hsin promised that when the time was right, she would give us and Xuanfang the answers we deserve.
Qingxiao: It seems... that "time" is now. Watcher Liangyu, kindly let her through.
Liangyu: ...Understood. I trust the Paragon's judgment.
Liangyu: Intendant, my apologies for the earlier offense... The Ministry of War's rules say you still need an escort to enter the Sanctum...
Rover: I'll go in with her.
Suoming: I have no objection.
Suoming: The Prism of Fate grants its bearer the authority to enter the Sanctum. Your presence there may be the variable that shifts everything.
Rover: And Qingxiao?
Qingxiao: ...I'll stay in the Hold. See to my duties as Xuan Paragon.
Qingxiao: Hsin charged me to act in Her stead should the tide ever become irreversible. Now I see She meant more than just the chaos Muyu caused.
Qingxiao: A Sentinel's waning frequency may spark trouble in the Hold. Someone must remain here to handle it.
Qingxiao: The Sanctum's matters... and Hsin, I leave to you. I have faith in you.
Rover: ...I understand.
Rover: I'll handle whatever's waiting for us in the Sanctum.
Qingxiao: Go, then.
Qingxiao: Be careful. In all things.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: ...I understand.
Rover: I'll handle whatever's waiting for us in the Sanctum.
Qingxiao: Go, then.
Qingxiao: Be careful. In all things.



Suoming: Has "She" really grown this weak...?
Suoming: There!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Reach the Heartscape Labyrinth]
Suoming: That little fox that showed us the way...
[Dialogue Option]  You recognize it?
[Dialogue Option]  Is it connected to Hsin?
Suoming: Its frequency resembles Hsin the Moon Fox's own, but it's still different from the Sentinel I've known.
Suoming: ...Arbiter. You lent me a hand in that fall. Thank you.
Rover: You still haven't explained what this "deal," this "covenant" with Hsin even is. I'm not letting you off the hook just yet.
Suoming: ...
Rover: But if Hsin really is in danger and the Sanctum could fall because of it, then finding Her comes first.
Rover: Let's go. We need to get out of this mist.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Suoming: You needn't worry about the consequences of the Sanctum's collapse, Arbiter. The Ministry has prepared for it.
Rover: (I'll take her at her word for now...)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Investigate the statue]
???: Here all the heart's faces show. Countless forms arise, shifting without end. Lose yourself among the false paths, and the way out shall be lost to you.
Suoming: Did you hear that?
Rover: Yeah. It was just a hum, but somehow I caught what it was trying to say.
Rover: Keep an eye out as we move forward.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Find a way out]
Suoming: What is this...
Rover: Is this what it meant by countless forms arising, shifting without end?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Find a way out]
Suoming: Arbiter, listen.
Rover: Mm. Strange noises.
Suoming: ...Something is following us.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Find a way out]
Suoming: Is it trying to keep us from leaving?
Rover: If so, then who's controlling this place...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Return to the starting point]
Suoming: We're back where we first started?
Rover: We won't find the way out like this. We—
Suoming: Arbiter, look.
Rover: Let's follow it.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Follow the little fox]
Rover: It's not just guiding us... is it controlling this place?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Follow the little fox]
Suoming: The way it shifts very much resembles Mengzhou's Automata Mechanics.
Rover: If this fox can work these mechanisms, then it might be...

content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Rover: Hm? I'm picking up an unusual frequency up ahead.
Suoming: Dangerous?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Suoming: It's stopped. So this is the source of the unusual frequency?
Rover: That's right. And the Prism of Fate seems to be reacting, too...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Overlook the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou
content:
[Objective: Overlook the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou]
Suoming: So this is the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou today. I wouldn't have guessed...
[Dialogue Option]  The Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
Suoming: As with the Xuanyuan Domain you visited before, it's one of the Manifold Dimensions Hsin commands.
[Dialogue Option]  You seem to know my comings and goings very well.
Suoming: I merely read of it in our Grand Library.
[Dialogue Option]  You've been here before?
Suoming: Supposedly, this place governs the base order of every mechanism in the Hold. It calculates the Manifold Forms, and you'd expect efficiency to come first, not extravagance.
Suoming: But such intricate, lifelike scenery... is not what I anticipated. Still, for Hsin the Moon Fox, such style is no surprise.
Rover: It's like the Xuanyuan Domain... Hsin once told me that was only a small part of the ...
Rover: What if... this place is connected to the Capsule as well?
Suoming: ...
Rover: I'm guessing by your reaction I'm right?
Suoming: ...The evidence is thin. I won't commit to an answer yet.

metadata.subsection: Overlook the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou

subsection: Use Sword Flight to head to the settlement
content:
[Objective: Use Sword Flight to head to the settlement]
Rover: (That silhouette on the horizon...)
Rover: (The mist is obscuring it, but it looks like... Hsin the Moon Fox?)

Rover: Is that...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: The first encounter with the Celestial
content:
[Objective: The first encounter with the Celestial]
???: ...Sector  has three corrupted registers. Tracing from the old framework... There. All sorted.
???: And that disturbance earlier... resolved too. Phew, that was close...
Rover: (A phantom? No... the way she's dressed...)
Rover: (Could she be one of the , like Ruoyun?)
???: Wha-! Wh-who are you? How did you get in here?
[Dialogue Option]  We've come to see Hsin.
???: You're... the Arbiter?
???: ...So you're Lady Hsin's guest. Pardon my manners.
[Dialogue Option]  And you are...?
Mingxiao: I'm Mingxiao, a Court of Savantae Artisan here in the Simulacrum Nexus. I handle maintenance and repairs in this area. Ah... outside, I suppose you'd call us Celestials?
Suoming: What's happened here?
Mingxiao: Well... lately, structures have been collapsing for unknown reasons. It's started to disrupt the Hold's operations. We're fixing them as fast as we can.
Rover: Unknown reasons?
Mingxiao: Yes. Ever since Lady Hsin decided to...
Mingxiao: My apologies... the restrictions forbid me from answering. But please, rest assured, it's safe here.
Suoming: Where is Hsin now?
Mingxiao: Lady Hsin... isn't able to see guests now. You may wait at Mengxuan Vale for the time being.
Mingxiao: ...Follow me, please.

metadata.subsection: The first encounter with the Celestial

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Head to Mengxuan Vale]
Suoming: ...Hmm.
Rover: Got something on your mind?
Suoming: Our Grand Library records that Sentinel Hsin and the Court of Savantae agreed that once the Hold was complete, the Artisans would surrender their lives and become conscious frequencies woven into the mechanisms. Part of the Sanctum's computational power.
Suoming: That meant losing their bodies, sense of self—everything that makes a person human.
Suoming: And yet they... seem no different from anyone else. Not exactly what I expected.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Enter Mengxuan Vale]
Mingxiao: Um... W-welcome to Mengxuan Vale.
Mingxiao: This used to be a place for the Celestials to rest. But with the Simulacrum Nexus's data anomalies increasing, Lady Hsin set up repair workshops all over. This is one of them.
Mingxiao: We so rarely have guests... do excuse us if we fall short. Whatever you'd like to know, Arbiter, I'll do my best to answer.
[Dialogue Option]  You knew I'd come?
Mingxiao: Lady Hsin's Prism of Fate isn't something just anyone can carry. Once, she told us that if a black-haired, golden-eyed person ever came bearing it, we should answer  questions as fully as possible.
Mingxiao: ...And you match that description exactly.
[Dialogue Option]  ...
Rover: I need to know where Hsin is now, as well as Her condition.
Rover: At this point... I'm not here to assign blame, but I'm done waiting for the moment to be "right." If Hsin the Moon Fox is caught in something, I'll find Her myself.
Rover: She's the Sentinel. Her every move could affect Xuanfang Hold's safety.
Mingxiao: That's... I understand your worry. It's just, Lady Hsin's power of Fractal Proliferation lets her exist across the entire Sanctum to guide the Hold's operations. And lately, with all the repairs, She's busier than ever...
Mingxiao: Even we... have not seen Lady Hsin's true form in a long time.
Suoming: Over there on the horizon. What is it?
Mingxiao: ...That is the , one of the Sentinel's manifestations. It resides outside the Simulacrum Nexus, occasionally acting on the Sentinel's behalf to... oversee matters.
Suoming: Do you know why we're here?
Mingxiao: To see Lady Hsin, surely?
Suoming: Of all the Sentinels in Huanglong, none are more "willful" than Hsin the Moon Fox. But She is not one to treat a covenant lightly.
Suoming: Xuanfang Hold is complete. The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs should have reclaimed the Civilization Capsule long ago. Hsin delayed. Again and again. Now the final term is past.
Suoming: As an Intendant in the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs, I have come to take it back. Will She yet hide from me?
Rover: Hsin?
Rover: (No, that gesture... is it a "threat"?)
Suoming: So this is what you've all been refusing to name.
Mingxiao: ...
Suoming: That response is answer enough. What you cannot say, I will learn for myself.
Mingxiao: Forgive me... nothing in the Sanctum escapes Lady Hsin. She must already know you've come.
Mingxiao: But we can't say for certain when you'll be able to see Her. While you wait for Her response, do explore as you like.
Mingxiao: I still have repairs to attend to. I'll take my leave.
[Dialogue Option]  Thanks for your explanation.
[Dialogue Option]  I see.
Abby: (Haa...)
Rover: (What's wrong?)
Abby: (Got jolted awake by some huge frequency wave! It was kinda like... that Prism of Fate, but with all these extra nasty, funky smells. Ugh...)
Rover: (Is it coming from that Fox Shadow on the horizon?)
Abby: (Uh-huh! Whatever's there has been giving me the willies since we got here. Like something's spying on me... Creepy. So I'm staying inside. If things get hairy, just holler!)
Rover: (Okay. Got it.)
Rover: (It seems like the Celestials here are bound by restrictions, just like Ruoyun was.)
Rover: (Now that I'm inside the Sanctum, I should take a look around.)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Talk to the  Celestials]
Pensive Celestial: Back when the Sentinel's computational power was still strong, She would often conjure Fractal Forms to come and amuse us in our workshops. "To keep us from getting bored," She said.
Pensive Celestial: And She would tell all sorts of stories and gossip from Xuanfang. She never could resist a good joke. Some had us laughing for days... Others, ahem, had us spinning for days.
Pensive Celestial: Not what you would expect from a Sentinel, is it? But that's exactly why, through all this, we haven't lost ourselves.
Pensive Celestial: A Celestial's frequency... does wear down over time. And yet, not one of us has ever been lost. Not one.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Pensive Celestial: A Celestial's frequency... does wear down over time. And yet, not one of us has ever been lost. Not one.



Resting Celestial: Hm? And you are...?
Resting Celestial: Oh! You must be that Arbiter Lady Hsin told us about! I never imagined someone from the outside world could make it in here...
Resting Celestial: How are things in the Hold these days? Is the Land of Xuanfang still safe?
[Dialogue Option]  (Briefly explain how things stand.)
Resting Celestial: So much has happened...
Rover: None of you knew what was going on out there?
Resting Celestial: No. Beyond the information needed to keep the Hold running, we Celestials barely interact across sectors, let alone with the world beyond the Sanctum.
Resting Celestial: Lady Hsin calls it "modular management," I think. She doesn't seem to like it much... but it is a restriction set from the Hold's founding. We've all come to accept it.
Rover: ...
Resting Celestial: It's alright. We're used to it. I thought becoming a Celestial would turn me into a heartless program, but Lady Hsin told us this place runs on "emotion" as its support, so She's been splitting off computational power just to keep our sense of self intact.
Resting Celestial: To ease the strain on our minds, we have no sense of time passing. I don't know how long it's been. The horror of the Fortress and Gorges War still feels like yesterday...
Resting Celestial: Thank you for telling me how Xuanfang is doing.
Resting Celestial: Well, I've rested enough. Time to get back to my modular parts and my duties.
Resting Celestial: ...Oh, and, Arbiter, the Lady Hsin of today is already... Ngh.
Rover: Are you all right?
Resting Celestial: Never mind... Sorry. It is a rare chance to be here. Please, take your time exploring.
Rover: (That reaction... is he afraid of the Fox Shadow?)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Look around]
Beleaguered Celestial: Oh, what am I supposed to do now...
[Dialogue Option]  You look troubled.
Beleaguered Celestial: It's these anomalies, what else... Oh, sorry, I thought you were... Wait. You're the Arbiter, aren't you?! I'm Leyue, I'm in charge of Autopuppet repairs here.
[Dialogue Option]  ...Does everyone here know who I am?
Leyue: Of course! The Sentinel told us to keep nothing from you. Let me guess, you want to know about the anomalies?
[Dialogue Option]  That's right.
Leyue: Let me just take you to see it. It's... a bit complicated.

Leyue: Incredible! You actually resolved the anomaly here!
[Dialogue Option]  Who knew the Prism of Fate was good for this...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Leyue: Incredible! You actually resolved the anomaly here!
[Dialogue Option]  Who knew the Prism of Fate was good for this...



Leyue: I've seen Lady Hsin use a Prism of Fate when She fixed the Sanctum. She said it was Her "backup plan." Now that it's in your hands, that means...
Leyue: I see it now, Arbiter! Maybe... maybe you're the only one who can save Hsin now.
Leyue: The Heart Realms shift with the Sentinel's heart. Countless changes, yet each follows a set rule. If you can find the anomaly, the Realms will return to balance...
Rover: Save? What exactly is Hsin the Moon Fox caught up in?
Leyue: ...I'm sorry. This is as much as I can share.
Leyue: But if you want to "see" Lady Hsin, this is the quickest way.
Rover: ...Got it. Finding Hsin the Moon Fox is why I came here in the first place. Tell me what to do.
Leyue: This is a Realm Key. With it, you can pass through an  into a Heart Realm. We can't activate the keys ourselves... but you can, with the Prism of Fate.
Leyue: Please, follow me!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Leyue: Please, follow me!



Leyue: ...This is the place.
Leyue: Anomalies like this were rare in the early days, but the few that cropped up, Lady Hsin would fix quickly.
[Dialogue Option]  Why does this happen?
Leyue: Lady Hsin said it's redundant data from repairing modular parts. But the root source... we've never been able to trace it.
Leyue: It seems to originate from the highest level of clearance. We cannot intervene. We can only wait for Lady Hsin to fix it Herself. And there are even more anomalies like this in the .
[Dialogue Option]  Heart Realms?
Leyue: They make up the innermost region of the Simulacrum Nexus, storing not only Xuanfang's history and culture, but also the Sentinel's own memories. Projections of Xuanfang's fate, its web of possibilities... Everything is held in Lady Hsin's keeping.
Leyue: We Celestials don't have the authority to enter the Heart Realms, so we can't fix the anomalies there. Right now, three Heart Realms are still in chaos.
Leyue: There's no way for us to share Her burden. All we can do is... Hold on. That frequency, it's...
Leyue: Th-this is Lady Hsin's power! Then maybe... Arbiter, come with me. Quickly!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Leyue: Th-this is Lady Hsin's power! Then maybe... Arbiter, come with me. Quickly!



Rover: What's happened to these Celestials?
Leyue: The anomalies have affected their consciousness. They're riddled with errors now... There's nothing we can do.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Return to the Inner Threshold]
Leyue: The Inner Threshold is inside Mengxuan Vale. This way, please.
[Dialogue Option]  After you.
[Dialogue Option]  Hold on.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the Inner Threshold in Mengxuan Vale
content:
[Objective: Head to the Inner Threshold in Mengxuan Vale]
Leyue: Arbiter, this is an Inner Threshold.
Leyue: As long as you hold the right key, it will take you deep into a Heart Realm.

metadata.subsection: Head to the Inner Threshold in Mengxuan Vale

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Enter the Inner Threshold]
Rover: Suoming, what is it?
Suoming: I'd say... after what I've gathered, the situation has become clear.
Suoming: Splitting Her computational power to maintain the Celestial's minds. Remolding the Simulacrum Nexus into lush landscapes...
Suoming: All of it fits what I know of Hsin the Moon Fox... She is soft on matters of the "human heart."
Suoming: And that's precisely why the Fox Shadow's behavior is so strange.
Rover: ...You suspect it's not acting on Hsin's will?
Suoming: Indeed. If that great shadow is the anomaly itself, then what has become of Hsin, who ought to be in control of this place?
Rover: And this is...?
Suoming: A Providence Lock. Should Hsin the Moon Fox seek to do anything against you, it will react.
Rover: Why are you giving me this?
Suoming: Trust it or don't, the choice is yours. I only mean to guard you against the worst.
Suoming: Tracking the anomalies in the Heart Realms is the obvious first step. But now I have a theory...
Suoming: ...That must be tested.
Suoming: ...Go find Her.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Head to the Heart of Flames
content:
[Objective: Head to the Heart of Flames]
Rover: (So this is the "Heart Realm" the Celestials talked about, deep in the Sanctum...)
Rover: (Suoming didn't seem like she'd lost control. She let herself be taken on purpose.)
Rover: (My Terminal... Signal's down, just as I thought. At least she and I agree on the priority. Finding the real Hsin the Moon Fox.)

metadata.subsection: Head to the Heart of Flames

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Stand up and start exploring]
Rover: ...Is that the same fox from earlier?

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Try communicating with the little fox
content:
[Objective: Try communicating with the little fox]
Abby: Ooh, its frequency... it smells similar to the one in the Prism of Fate!
Rover: Are you... "Hsin's" messenger?
Abby: Why doesn't the Moon Fox just come to you Herself? I mean, She created this whole place. What could possibly trap Her?
Rover: I'm afraid it's not that simple.
Abby: Ugh, why's it always such a mess... Oh! Come to think of it, that thing the umbrella girl was holding had Hsin's frequency in it, too. Only kinda different...
Rover: Different how...?
Abby: Umm, like... plain rice versus egg fried rice? Both rice, sure, but the girl's had a lot more flavor... Hey! Hey! Are you ever gonna stop petting that fox?!
Rover: ...!
Abby: What, now it's taking our stuff—!
Rover: ...Is it leading me through there?
Abby: ...
Rover: ...Abby?
Abby: You... wha... how'd you turn into that?
Rover: ...
Abby: ...What the heck is going on here?!
Rover: The Celestial said the Sanctum shifts with Hsin the Moon Fox's heart, but that every change follows a rule. Could this... be one of those rules at work?
Abby: What kind of rule swaps people and foxes around...? So you think She's behind this?
Rover: If some restrictions kept me from acting freely, I'd find another way to get my message across, too.
Rover: I sensed nothing hostile from that fox. Maybe... I can only move through this Heart Realm in this form?
???: A thousand lanterns line up like clouds in motion, their songs and steps wake the sleeping stars.
???: If mortal smiles might yet be born of this, what harm to walk by moon and lantern light?
Rover: ...Was that Hsin?
???: ...Light the lanterns, gather the guests... Invite the Moon... All beings... rejoice...
Rover: "Light the lanterns, gather the guests"... Every lantern here is unlit.
Rover: Better keep moving for now.

metadata.subsection: Try communicating with the little fox

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Abby: You feeling okay in there?
Rover: I'm fine. Just... can't really swing a sword like this.
Abby: Hehe, relax. I've got your back!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Rover: It went that way.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Catch up to the little fox
content:
[Objective: Catch up to the little fox]
Rover: It returned the Prism of Fate... It was only showing me the way all along.
Rover: Hsin... what is it you truly want me to do?

metadata.subsection: Catch up to the little fox

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Lexiao: Have you lost your mind? Out here lighting lanterns alone, at a time like this!
Lexiao: You know full well lantern light draws the Formrenders. Last time, you almost got...
Luobin: I've been watching. They've gone quiet for now. Let me give it another go.
Luobin: Wh-what's that?
Lexiao: Forget the lantern. Run!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Go take a look]
Rover: ("Light the lanterns, gather the guests"... Am I supposed to light these?)
Rover: (I'll pick up that Moon Lantern first.)

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Listen in on the residents' conversations
content:
[Objective: Listen in on the residents' conversations]
Jianwei: Three more gone just like that. Now Nightlight Tokens are running low. This year's Waking Moon Festival... I doubt we can hold it.
Yunsong: Ugh. All I want is to light one lantern. Say a prayer for peace. When did that get so hard?
Yunsong: And these Formrenders, heaven knows where those monsters came from. Not Autopuppets, not Tacet Discords... Just show up and snuff out any lantern they see, like they're possessed.
Yunsong: One nearly got that boy Luobin last time...
Jianwei: What else can we do? We've tried everything. These things won't leave. All of us are on edge.
Yunsong: Say... if we can't hold the festival, do you think Lady Hsin will still come?
Yunsong: ...Has She given up on us?
Jianwei: Don't say such things. Why else would the Sentinel have built the Hold?
Jianwei: Let's lay low for now. Wait it out.
Yunsong: Haah, thought we'd finally catch a break after the Fortress and Gorges War.
Yunsong: Hm... how long ago was that again? Funny, I can't seem to remember...

metadata.subsection: Listen in on the residents' conversations

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Remove the seal]
Rover: Was that the Prism of Fate resonating?
Abby: Hehe, this gizmo Hsin gave you is pretty handy, huh!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Abby: Weird. What kind of monster exists just to snuff out lanterns?
Rover: The Waking Moon Festival is an age-old tradition in the Land of Xuanfang, but here they're saying it can't be held this year.
Rover: What if the way to reach Hsin in this Heart Realm is to make the festival happen first?
Rover: Let's try lighting up those lanterns.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Light the lanterns]
Rover: ...!

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
subsection: Catch up to Hsin the Moon Fox's phantom
content:
???: Arbiter.
[Dialogue Option]  Hsin the Moon Fox?
Rover: ...Let's skip the pleasantries.
Rover: You've been missing for some time. Where were you? What happened to you?
Hsin: What you saw before was merely a fractured strand of myself. My true form still sleeps deep within the Simulacrum Nexus.
Hsin: I thought I could spare the strength to find you. But anomalies kept appearing. I've had to pour everything into repairs. I'm spread... terribly thin.
Hsin: Even now, I can only speak to you in this unstable form.
Rover: From what I gathered, Muyu's corrupted Reverberations have all been purged. Xuanfang Hold should be safe now.
Rover: What is truly binding you, Hsin?
Hsin: Ha. Nothing escapes you.
[Dialogue Option]  Is it the Fox Shadow?
Rover: It has your face. Your frequency. But every Celestial I met spoke of it with dread. I think they were under some kind of restriction.
Rover: The Heart Realm anomalies, the canceled Waking Moon Festival... Is the Fox Shadow behind it all?
Rover: It took Suoming too. Do you know where she is now?
Hsin: Mm... that is a lot of questions at once...
Hsin: That "Nexus Fox Shadow," let's call it "Suhsin." It began to break free of my control after I decided to remold the Civilization Capsule. Since then, it has been spreading through the Nexus.
Hsin: Suhsin seeks to devour all "Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox" data to stabilize its own existence. It's been fighting me for control over Xuanfang Hold. In our struggle, I took my eyes off the Hold. A part of the Sanctum collapsed because of it.
Hsin: As for that girl with the umbrella, she deliberately released the Moon Fox frequency in her token to lure Suhsin into taking her. Reaching Suhsin was her goal all along.
Hsin: But the Heart Realm she's in now... is currently beyond my reach.
Hsin: Hm... but there is one simple way to make Suhsin obey your every command.
[Dialogue Option]  What is it?
Hsin: Use the power within the Prism of Fate to overwrite my personality data and reset all clearances. Since Suhsin shares my source code, it will revert to its initial state.
[Dialogue Option]  And what would happen to you?
Hsin: Well, I'd lose my sense of self and exist solely as the core to keep Xuanfang Hold running, wouldn't I?
[Dialogue Option]  ...
[Dialogue Option]  I won't allow that to happen.
Hsin: Aw, not that frown, Arbiter. I was only joking.
Rover: Why was Suhsin able to drive you into such a corner? What could override a Sentinel's authority?
Hsin: Suhsin's clearance... comes from the Civilization Capsule's base code. Its core logic dictates that once Xuanfang Hold fulfills its mission, it must be destroyed. To keep the Hold, I had no choice but to overwrite it with new logic.
Rover: So that's the reason you remolded the Capsule?
Hsin: ...Yes.
Hsin: Shh. Tread lightly. We wouldn't want a giant hand to appear and snatch us both away!
Rover: Then let me ask you this: are the things shown in the Heart Realms your memories?
Hsin: ...They are.
Rover: You made Xuanfang's very first Rafter Kite, didn't you? Then who is the "It" you mentioned to that Rafter Kite?
Hsin: That is—
Hsin: Ah... my time in human form is up.
Rover: Tell me, what do you need me to do now?
Hsin: Arbiter, please continue through the Heart Realms. Venture deep into the Simulacrum Nexus to fix the anomalies. I will be waiting at the end of the next Realm.
Hsin: What I am forbidden to say aloud is hidden within those fragments of the past. Once you have witnessed everything, you will understand why I brought you here.
Hsin: ...Forgive me.
Rover: The Providence Lock didn't react. Guess Hsin was telling the truth.
Rover: What's that over there...?

content:
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: The meeting hall is right ahead, my Lady.

Hsin the Moon Fox: I have summoned you today to address the Tacet Discord threat plaguing our borders.
Rover: (Is that... Hsin?)
Hsin the Moon Fox: I will build a city, a mechanism of ever-changing forms, designed to counter Tacet Discord outbreaks.
Hsin the Moon Fox: To bring it into being, I need the backing of our finest Artisans. But before you commit, you must know the price—
Hsin the Moon Fox: Those who build this city shall never return.
Court of Savantae Delegate: This... this technology outlined in the blueprint is unprecedented. Could it be...?
Hsin the Moon Fox: Correct. It originates from .
Court of Savantae Delegate: The Court of Savantae pledges its full support!
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Zhuojun Atelier raises no objections.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: Delegates, present your qualifications in turn. The Sentinel will render Her judgment based on the facts.
Court of Savantae Delegate: We have long studied Sentinel technology. Our knowledge guarantees we can decipher this blueprint in the shortest time.
Court of Savantae Delegate: As for the price, we stopped counting the cost of life and death ever since we built the Chronosorter. What does it matter if there's no way back?
Court of Savantae Delegate: Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Xuanfang's terrain is volatile. It will require real-time adjustments to mechanism formations. Our knowledge of the local environment gives us the upper hand.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: As Lady Hsin noted, this city requires highly sophisticated mechanisms. Yuan Fortress, the very ground beneath the chosen site, was built by our hands. Navigating those intricacies is where we excel.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: We will master this technology, of that we are certain. And we are ready to give our lives for Mengzhou.
Court of Savantae Delegate: If it's mechanisms you need, we have reserves in spades.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: We are local. We know the people. We are the best suited to move them safely.
Hsin the Moon Fox: This construction cannot afford to fail. I need those who are unwavering in their acceptance of this technology.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Zhuojun Atelier is making this unnecessarily complicated.
Intendant of Sentinel Affairs: The decision is made. Xuanfang Hold will be built by the Court of Savantae. Effective immediately.
Zhuojun Atelier Delegate: Please, one final word! The Court of Savantae lacks practical experience in large-scale mechanism engineering—
Hsin the Moon Fox: The Ministry will coordinate with City Hall. I want logistics sorted and materials dispatched within three days. As for you...
Hsin the Moon Fox: Submit your personnel roster to the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs by tomorrow. Any delay will be treated as a forfeit.
Court of Savantae Delegate: Understood.

Hsin the Moon Fox: They are willing to destroy themselves for true knowledge. Naturally, they will preserve such technology at any cost. To them, death is merely an acceptable compromise.

Qingxiao: But... this land without you will forever be incomplete.
Qingxiao: There are so many people waiting for you.



Xuanfang Wardens: ...Since the shift change two nights ago, Ovathrax launched a surprise raid at Desorock Highland, pushing straight toward the Clouded Cliffs.
Xuanfang Wardens: It's broken our front lines and is nearing Yuan Fortress. Based on the Outriders' reports, it will reach the gates in thirty minutes.
Xuanfang Wardens: The Threnodian clearly knew about Xuanfang Hold's construction... and planned this raid strategically. The Tacet Discords' assault is fierce. They've reached the mountain gates. We've already...
Hsin: ...
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin, you...
Hsin: ...
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin? Are you with me?
Hsin: ...Is there anyone left who can retreat?
Xuanfang Wardens: A message came from the Central Plains. Only two words—
Xuanfang Wardens: "No retreat."
Xuanfang Wardens: We are holding here to establish a second line of defense. Ensure the civilians and critical mechanisms can evacuate.
Xuanfang Wardens: Lady Hsin, as long as you're here, we still stand a chance. There will be a future for Xuanfang. Please—
Hsin: You want me to leave and fight another day, don't you?
Hsin: I understand your intent, but... my answer is the same as yours. The same two words.
[Dialogue Option]  No retreat.
Hsin: Every moment I stay is one more life I can save.
Xuanfang Wardens: My lady...
Hsin: Enough. That is final. What is the status of the civilians?
Xuanfang Wardens: Most have been evacuated, but some remain trapped near Yuan Fortress.
Xuanfang Wardens: The perimeter is swarming with monsters summoned by Ovathrax. With our current forces... a full breakout is impossible.
Xuanfang Wardens: But there are weak points. We can still carve a path through.
Hsin: Prioritize the civilians. Notify all units...
Hsin: In the name of Hsin the Moon Fox... In the name of the Sentinel of this land, follow my command. I will ensure everyone lives to see tomorrow.
Xuanfang Wardens: ...Understood! I will inform all units!
Hsin: Wait. Before you go, tell me your name.
Xuanfang Wardens: I am . My mother told me a Xuanling Bird flew by when I was born, so she gave me this name. An interesting coincidence.
Hsin: Yuxian... Good. I will remember it.
Hsin: In this outbreak, the odds are slim. The least I can do is carry your names with me.
Hsin: Remember: no matter what, I stand with you.
Yuxian: ...Understood. Lady Hsin, it is time for me to return to the battlefield.
Xuanling Bird: When you first arrived, that boy was barely seven. Now, he looks like a true "pillar" of the force.
Xuanling Bird: And you, Little Fox? The enemy is at the gates, Jinzhou's affairs remain unresolved, and the true Sentinel is nowhere to be found.
Xuanling Bird: The Threnodian knew our moves from the start. Waiting is death. Fighting is death. Even you, in your innocence, must see this is a stalemate.
Hsin: Even if death awaits us either way, I cannot sit by.
Hsin: Even if Ovathrax did not come today, it would eventually. We built Xuanfang to fight it.
Hsin: All I can do is respond to the turn of battle and deploy Autopuppets as needed. At the very least, the civilians must be evacuated.
Xuanling Bird: The battlefield shifts in a breath. Even with your Prism of Fate to see it all, relaying orders to every flank at once is impossible.
Hsin: That's exactly why you are here, isn't it?
Xuanling Bird: ...Little Fox, have you thought this through?
Hsin: Yes.
Xuanling Bird: Then I will watch the battlefield for you and help you relay your commands.
Hsin: Some of the civilians are still trapped... We must prioritize their safety.
Hsin: I will buy them time.
Hsin: These monsters have no mind of their own. They blindly pursue "people"...
Hsin: No... Are they drawn to "battle"?
Hsin: If that is the case...
Hsin: Heh. So that is it.
Xuanling Bird: Well done, Little Fox. The monsters are withdrawing.
Hsin: Xuanling, tell everyone to stay hidden and move away from the Tacet Discords.
Xuanling Bird: Good. Now the trapped citizens can escape.
Hsin: How is our communication with Mingting? Any news?
Xuanling Bird: The distress signal went out. But even at top speed, they are still five days away.
Hsin: Five days... Too late.
Hsin: The situation at the Gorges of Spirits is no better. We have to rely on these Autopuppets...
Xuanling Bird: They keep coming...
Hsin: Xuanling, tell everyone the civilians should be safe now. As for the rest... If it comes to it, save yourself first.
Xuanling Bird: But...
Hsin: I know. Xuanfang is the bridge between Mengzhou and the Jinzhou of the future. It cannot fall.
Hsin: Yuan Fortress is the choke point. Once it falls, all of Xuanfang becomes as fragile as paper against the swarms.
Hsin: I will find a way. If necessary... you know, I am also "Hsin the Moon Fox."
Hsin: Still not enough... I have to find another way...
Hsin: ...Hm?!
Hsin: What... There are still people who haven't left?!
Xuanling Bird: They refused to go.
Xuanling Bird: The Warden Commander asked me to deliver this message.
Hsin: ...What did he say?
Xuanling Bird: He said Yuxian passed on your orders. They each found stones and carved their names into them.
Xuanling Bird: He has also organized the Artisans and Wardens to move to other sectors.
Xuanling Bird: He said... as long as you are here, and as long as the Lexicon Axis you established stands, even on scorched earth, Xuanfang still has a future.
Hsin: ...Scorched earth?
Hsin: No. Xuanling, tell him not to do anything stupid!
Xuanling Bird: It is... too late.
Hsin: ...
Xuanling Bird: You said you would stand with the people of Xuanfang, didn't you?
Xuanling Bird: They, in turn, stand with the Sentinel who guards this land.
Hsin: ...
Xuanling Bird: Little Fox, they all believe in you... We have no time for despair.
Xuanling Bird: Most of the civilians were evacuated. Now we should help the Artisans still out there on the battlefield.
Xuanling Bird: Before the explosion, Ruoyun relocated them all. I've marked their locations for you.
Hsin: Mm.
Xuanling Bird: Pull yourself together, Little Fox. Who are you pulling that long face for?
Hsin: I...
Xuanling Bird: There were seven thousand souls here. You saved most of them amidst a relentless attack. What more do you want?
Xuanling Bird: Wake up! You keep insisting you're also "Hsin the Moon Fox," remember?
Xuanling Bird: What about the rest of the people? Let them die? They're all waiting for the Sentinel's commands.
Hsin: I... I am sorry... I...
Xuanling Bird: Tell me, what do you want, Little Fox?
Hsin: I want them all to escape and live.
Hsin: Xuanling, how much can you see?
Xuanling Bird: Not much. The Threnodian's influence is too strong. Most of my companions can barely fly.
Hsin: It's alright. Evacuate the front lines. Try to find survivors along the way and guide them to me.
Hsin: We only need to hold until the last of them gather. Then I will create a new path for everyone to leave together.
Xuanling Bird: Rest assured. The Artisans who failed to evacuate in time have already been guided to the vicinity of the Lexicon Axis.
Hsin: Good. You and your companions can also follow them back now.
Xuanling Bird: Us...?
Xuanling Bird: Little Fox, this may be the last you hear from me.
Xuanling Bird: The Autopuppets cannot draw enough attention. Slow as Ovathrax is, it has already turned its eye toward Xuanfang.
Xuanling Bird: There are soldiers still in the field. I will buy them time to reach the Axis.
Hsin: ...Xuanling.
Xuanling Bird: Hush now, Little Fox. Even with the Sentinel here, the Xuanling are still the guardian spirits of this land.
Xuanling Bird: Fate willing, we will meet again, Little Fox.
Xuanling Bird: What remains is yours to carry, Sentinel—"Hsin."
Hsin: ...
Hsin: ...
Hsin: ...
???: Lady Hsin, can you hear me now?
Hsin: ...
???: The Wardens gave their lives for the Hold. The Xuanling Birds used their flesh to destroy the Fortress. We are at the brink, but this, right now, is also our opening.
???: The Tacet Discords are all gathered here. Now is the moment to finish them in one sweep.
???: Do you remember what you told us? If we merge with the Axis and surrender our own will, we can accelerate the Hold's completion.
Hsin: You are... offering to become Celestials?
???: It is as we promised—those who build the Hold do not return.
???: Lady Hsin, this is the "price" we are willing to pay.
???: We know your concerns. One shouldn't be greedy, that is true. But... hehe, people like us are the greediest of all.
???: "Know the Way at dawn, die without regret at dusk."
???: But if I offer this body to my homeland at dawn, only to know the Way once more at dusk—what could be better?
???: This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—
Hsin: ...

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
???: This battle determines Xuanfang's fate. Lady Hsin, from now on, we are one with this Hold—
Hsin: ...



Hsin: ...Mm.
Hsin: At this point, if I still hesitate, I might as well cast aside this human form.

Hsin: In the end, I was never truly a Sentinel.

Hsin: Perhaps it is this "heart" that kept me from ever becoming "Hsin the Moon Fox."

content:
[Objective: Return to the Heartscape Labyrinth]
Hsin: ...
Rover: What I just saw... That was everything you went through, wasn't it?
Rover: ...You gave everything you had.
Hsin: You've been in Xuanfang for a while now, Arbiter. Have you visited the Ministry of War?
Hsin: There is a stone tablet there. Every single one of their names is engraved upon it.
Hsin: I merely waved my hand. I merely offered a few words of judgment. They all acted on their own accord.
Hsin: They walked away from the path I instructed and shielded a Hold that was never meant to exist. They gave their lives without a second thought.
Hsin: In the end, all that remains of them is a name carved into cold stone. Faint. Hollow. One after another.
Hsin: If no one speaks of them, they will be forgotten as if they never were.
Rover: They didn't throw themselves into the fire just to be remembered forever.
Rover: Hsin, you already did everything you could. They surely knew that. The circumstances...
Hsin: The circumstances left no other choice, I know.
Hsin: Speaking of which, I have been swept along by such circumstances many times.
Hsin: Take past lantern festivals, for instance. In the form of a little fox, I could see their pain, but all I could offer were small gestures of comfort.
Hsin: Sometimes I wondered... was my presence alone enough?
Hsin: As long as I appeared before them, they felt safe. Happy. They believed they could endure the hard days.
Hsin: But my reach was so limited, just as it is now. How is this any different from facing the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs back then?
Hsin: I took a Capsule and ran. I ran and ran, searching for somewhere safe.
Hsin: And they... they were all waiting for me to appear. Waiting for me to stand before them.
Hsin: Round and round, and in the end, I am still that little fox.
Hsin: But now, it should be different. After all, I have you with me now.
Hsin: Thanks to you, I have seized more and more authority from Suhsin—from the "Sentinel's true will." The more I take, the more power I command.
[Dialogue Option]  The "Sentinel's true will"?
Hsin: Yes, the Sentinel's underlying logic. Its true will.
Hsin: The Sentinel believed that my remolding of the Civilization Capsule, my choice to preserve Xuanfang Hold, was a violation of the rules. A "loss of control." So it has been trying to reclaim the Hold to force it back onto its ordained path of ruin.
Hsin: But thanks to you, I have gained the upper hand. The "anomalies" you fixed along the way have been strengthening my new authority.
Hsin: —To break free from the Sentinel's will and forge new rules with my own hands.
Hsin: With authority like that, I can finally do what the true "Hsin the Moon Fox" once could.
Hsin: That girl carries my scent. It will make finding her easier.
Hsin: Come, Arbiter. I know you still harbor many questions.
Hsin: But right now, finding her and restoring Xuanfang Hold is what matters more, isn't it?
Rover: When all this is over, tell me what you're still holding back, okay?
Hsin: Yes... I will when "all this" is over.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Continue onward]
Hsin: You should be relieved to hear I have reclaimed most of my authority from Suhsin.
Hsin: This Labyrinth is now entirely mine to command.
Hsin: Everything you wish to know, I will lay before you, piece by piece, through this Labyrinth. Honestly and fully.
Rover: (The ...?)
Abby: (Tch... Seems like that thingamabob that red-haired girl gave you is acting up.)
Abby: (Didn't she say it would react if Hsin the Moon Fox wanted to do something against you?)
Hsin: Arbiter?
Rover: I'm fine. Just a bit dizzy from the emotional whiplash. Let's keep moving.
Hsin: Mm... this Labyrinth reaches into one's very soul. You have lingered in my Heartscapes for too long; some discomfort is natural.
Hsin: Once we are out, I will make it up to you. How does that sound?
Rover: ...Mm.

content:
Hsin: Xuanfang Hold... would have peace forevermore.
Rover: Hsin...
Rover: You don't have to lie anymore



Hsin: What's that... Suoming gave it to you, didn't she?
Rover: You recognize it.
Hsin: Had I known you were carrying it, I wouldn't have had to put on such a show. All those stories I spun for you...
Hsin: ...
Rover: Everything you said is true. You really wanted to be with the people of Xuanfang. To see the sea of lights at the festival again. To see Hsin the Moon Fox once more.
Rover: But... you simply can't.
Rover: Hsin, tell me, was the cost of remolding the Civilization Capsule your own life?
Hsin: I...
Rover: Whatever you're planning, don't sacrifice yourself. I'm here. There's no need for you to bear this alone.
Hsin: Arbiter... I...
Rover: You did well, Hsin. You held everything together while I was away. That wasn't easy.
Hsin: Arbiter, don't try to—
Hsin: Don't say comforting things like that... I... I...
Rover: Hsin...?
Hsin: The Sentinel is dead!
Hsin: You saw it yourself... The founding of Xuanfang... came at the cost of further damaging the Civilization Capsule...
Hsin: I was born from the hope of restoring it! I knew my duty. I knew how much the Moon Fox had entrusted me with.
Hsin: But I... but I... I betrayed that hope. I betrayed the very duty I was born to carry.
Hsin: After that, I could feel Its frequency waning with each passing day. I tried so many things. I tried everything...
Hsin: But just as I couldn't stop It from walking into that trap, I couldn't catch up to the fading of Its frequency.
Hsin: Until... I could no longer sense It. And the Civilization Capsule stopped draining my power, and instead began to feed me...
Hsin: I knew... It was gone. And I had caused Its death.
Hsin: Arbiter... Rover... I...
Hsin: I believe... what people need is Hsin the Moon Fox, not a diminished Fractal Form...
Rover: What were you planning to do behind my back?
Hsin: If I reclaimed Suhsin's power, I could awaken the Sentinel's will from the  of the Civilization Capsule... Its true will.
Hsin: If I gave myself up, the true Sentinel could return! Its memories might be incomplete, but... even so, It would be the true Sentinel.
Rover: You're already a piece of the Moon Fox. If you disappear, how can you be certain that what returns is truly the Sentinel?
Hsin: ...?
Rover: Hsin, I've had this on me since I first entered the Labyrinth. It only reacts if you intend to do something against me.
Rover: You lied to me many times along the way, but this Lock only warned me just now.
Rover: Because even you believed... that if I learned the truth later, it would affect me as Arbiter more than anything else. Am I right?
Hsin: Arbiter... I...!
Hsin: I thought if I couldn't bring the Sentinel back...
Rover: You aren't afraid of death, yet you fear this?
Rover: Hsin, all you wanted was to use "Arbiter" as an excuse to justify your escape, didn't you?
Rover: You had the courage to stay in a Xuanfang ravaged by Tacet Discords, but no courage to face yourself.
Rover: If the true Sentinel had made the decision, it would've been better. Wiser. More foolproof for Xuanfang, Mengzhou, even Solaris.
Rover: If It were here, even in circumstances like this, It would never have let Muyu's chaos take root.
Rover: You're trapped in self-doubt. You never give your own effort its due.
Hsin: ...
Rover: The death of Sentinel Hsin the Moon Fox is my responsibility as Arbiter. I will uncover the truth.
Rover: And the wrongdoings of the Sentinel's Fractal Form will be judged once the dust settles.
Rover: But for these past hundred years, it's been you leading the people of Mengzhou forward.
Rover: Hsin, will you betray the hopes they place in you?

Hsin the Moon Fox: The Arbiter and Suoming will not give it the chance.
Hsin: Sentinel... I am so—
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, I am sorry.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I knew you were born of feeling. Your capacity for joy and sorrow far exceeds my own.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Remolding the Civilization Capsule would trap you between cruelties, and the grief would eat you alive.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I am truly sorry.
Hsin: The fault is my own! If only I had not—

Hsin the Moon Fox: If it had been you,  might still be here today...
Hsin: But—if I hadn't... If you were still here...
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin. The day you were born, I envisioned your future.
Hsin the Moon Fox: I envisioned how you would laugh, cry, and find your place in this world...
Hsin: But I've stumbled every step of the way. I do not deserve your... faith.
Hsin the Moon Fox: You saved thousands in the Fortress and the Gorges War. You guarded the Civilization Capsule for centuries to make its restoration possible. You brought hope where there was none.
Hsin the Moon Fox: You have long been revered as the divinity you are—the very heart of Mengzhou.
Hsin the Moon Fox: Go. Walk forward, one step at a time. Walk farther and better than I ever could.
