title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suhsin the Inevitable: Hsin... If you insist on defying the ordained path, I shall reveal... the full weight of my power.



Hsin: Suhsin, look. The Simulacrum Nexus. Our Civilization Capsule is so vast, so varied.
Hsin: The Heart of Stillness is wide and welcoming. The Heart of Flames is fierce and thriving. The Heart of Frost is still and steady. The Heart of Bloom is peaceful and pleasant.
Suhsin the Inevitable: In other words: compromise, impulse, indifference, and mediocrity.
Hsin: True. It is greed, pleasure, and the endless hustle. And yet, it is also life, endless and enduring.
Hsin: This is humanity. This is emotion. This is the heart. This is—civilization.
Hsin: How could you strip them of that? And leave only reason, logic, and cold principles?
Suhsin the Inevitable: You defy your own origin. You overturn what is ordained. Even with your divine cunning, the path ahead remains a chaos no stratagem can pierce... much like the error of my own existence.
Hsin: A chaos no stratagem can pierce? How frightening. Then let us walk that path together.
Hsin: The remolding of the Civilization Capsule is nearly complete. The remains the Fractsidus stole will no longer be enough to shake Mengzhou.
Hsin: I will stop Xuanfang Hold's collapse and gather those Celestials whose wills are spent, those on the verge of fading, into my Prism of Fate.
Hsin: There they will remain, until the day I find them a place to belong.
Suhsin the Inevitable: This exposes forbidden secrets. It is unbefitting a Sentinel.
Suhsin the Inevitable: But... anyone who possesses a heart would do the same.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suhsin the Inevitable: But... anyone who possesses a heart would do the same.



Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, you truly are capable of becoming a Sentinel like no other.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin the Moon Fox: Hsin, you truly are capable of becoming a Sentinel like no other.



Happy Boy: Hurry! The Lantern Carriage is about to leave!
Happy Girl: Wait for me!
Hsin: The Waking Moon Festival... It feels like another lifetime.
Rover: Hsin, why are you still here? The whole city is waiting for you.
Hsin: They have waited so long to see me. If I simply strolled through the streets, wouldn't I disappoint them?
Hsin: As always, I must wait until the festival reaches its peak, until every heart is full of aching anticipation—
Hsin: Arbiter, do you think all the Sentinels feel this restless and giddy? I can barely stand to wait a moment longer.
Rover: You all show it differently, but you all feel in similar ways.
Hsin: Quite so. And what I feel only deepens with every passing moment.
Hsin: So, Arbiter... that plan of yours, to tell everyone the truth about Hsin? Let's wait. Just a little longer.
[Dialogue Option]  Hsin...
Hsin: It told me to find my place in this world... And I think, what I want most right now, is this.
Hsin: To give them a sense of safety. A sense of peace. Not because I am expected to... but because I want to.
Hsin: The dark currents of Mengzhou have yet to be purged at the root. Whether "Hsin" appears is secondary. What matters is whether the Sentinel still endures.
Rover: If that is what you've decided, then do as you wish.
Hsin: Then I gratefully accept your approval, Arbiter.
Hsin: And truly, in this moment I feel no regret. No loneliness. Because I know... as long as Hsin is here...
Hsin: This Waking Moon Festival, and all the lanterns yet to come... they will shine on, countless and bright.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: This Waking Moon Festival, and all the lanterns yet to come... they will shine on, countless and bright.



Actor No. 1: During the Manifold Sanctum restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Actor No. 2: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Actor No. 1: During the Manifold Sanctum restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Actor No. 2: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.



Hsin: For a hundred years, I rebuilt countless landscapes and cultures within the Capsule.
Hsin: None of it compares to the warmth of this. Real light, living and breathing.
Rover: Yes, the cold projections of the past have transformed into the warm scene before us now.
Hsin: The road ahead is long. For the next thousand dawns and dusks, I will be the one to watch over Mengzhou.
Hsin: Here, it is customary to write the year's joys on the lantern.
Rover: Then what will you write?
Hsin: Hehe, the one who gathers all the wishes doesn't release her own.
Hsin: What will you write, Arbiter?
Rover: I...
Hsin: Arbiter, the night has come. Let us walk into the Waking Moon together.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: What will you write, Arbiter?
Rover: I...
Hsin: Arbiter, the night has come. Let us walk into the Waking Moon together.



Hsin: Oh? Is there something else on your mind, Arbiter?
[Dialogue Option]  What will become of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou?
Hsin: The turmoil within the Simulacrum Nexus hasn't fully quieted yet. Until then, I cannot reclaim it.
Hsin: I have left a portion of my frequency and power with the Nexus Fox Shadow. It will join the remaining Celestials in finishing the work.
Hsin: Once the dust has settled, I will take over from there.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to ask something else.
[Dialogue Option]  Has the Civilization Capsule been fully remolded?
Hsin: Mm, you could say the grand design is finally taking shape. A portion of its power is still stabilizing the Nexus's framework, much like the Xuanyuan Domain once separated to sustain Xuanfang Hold.
Hsin: At the very least, the Fractsidus can no longer use the remains they stole away to interfere with the Capsule.
Hsin: Our counterattack begins right here.
[Dialogue Option]  I want to ask something else.
[Dialogue Option]  I'll see you at the Waking Moon Festival.
Hsin: Mm. Do look forward to it, Arbiter. The Waking Moon brings its own delights.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
[Objective: Look for Suoming]
Suoming: Arbiter, you head to the festival first. I still have matters to settle with the Ministry.
Rover: Sure, if you get some rest. At least tonight.
Suoming: I already have. Sampling Tangning's Moon Fox Rice Cakes was a start.
Suoming: I imagine the ones at the festival... will taste even better.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: I already have. Sampling Tangning's Moon Fox Rice Cakes was a start.
Suoming: I imagine the ones at the festival... will taste even better.



Suoming: During the Manifold Sanctum's restoration, see that no corners are cut.
Qiting: Rest assured, Intendant Suoming.
Rover: Suoming, do you ever take a break?
Suoming: Arbiter.
Qiting: Ah! So this is—
Qiling: W-wow, Qiting, could I ask the Arbiter for an... autograph?
Suoming: Have some decorum.
Qiting & Qiling: I'm sorry, Intendant Suoming!
Suoming: These two still have much to learn, but they show promise. I assigned them to oversee the Sanctum's repairs. The entrance to the Simulacrum Nexus is still inside, after all.
Suoming: Besides, Hsin the Moon Fox will appear before the people tonight. First time in years. I cannot afford to relax.
Rover: Looks like it'd take Hsin hiding your umbrella and locking you away in some quiet garden to get you to rest.
Suoming: Arbiter... That sounds exactly like what She would do.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: Arbiter... That sounds exactly like what She would do.



Suoming: Arbiter.
Rover: Am I interrupting?
Suoming: No. My conversation with them has concluded.
Rover: "Them"? You mean in the lock...
Suoming: Yes... Every now and then, I commune with... their frequencies.
Suoming: Though, to be precise, it's merely speaking to myself. I refrain from doing it in the presence of others.
Suoming: But Suhsin recreated one of the subordinates I was most fond of... It reminded me of how much I miss them.
Rover: I see. Would you allow me to say a few words to them?
Rover: What did they usually call you?
Suoming: Seal Master, Boss, Sister Suoming... They had many names for me.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Seal Master)
Rover: Your Seal Master is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Boss)
Rover: Your Boss is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
[Dialogue Option]  (Call her Sister Suoming)
Rover: Your Sister Suoming is extraordinary. She carried Mengzhou through centuries when the Sentinel wasn't there to govern its affairs.
Rover: And she did it flawlessly. Now, with her counsel, Hsin will become a Sentinel like no other.
Rover: Not just in the past, but in the future too, she'll keep giving you every reason to never regret following her.
Suoming: The last time I cried was when they were taken from me. Now...
Suoming: To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
Suoming: Thank you, Arbiter.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: To have someone else speak to them... It feels good, like they're still here.
Suoming: Thank you, Arbiter.



Rover: Suoming, I still know very little about the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... There's something I've been wondering.
Suoming: Ask freely.
Rover: The condition a Sentinel is in can profoundly affect a civilization. I've... seen that firsthand before.
Rover: After Hsin the Moon Fox was attacked, and Hsin was in Xuanfang Hold for a century remolding the Civilization Capsule, what became of the people of Mengzhou?
Suoming: ...
Rover: Suoming?
Suoming: Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: Suoming?
Suoming: Not long after the assassination, a Waveworn Phenomenon we called the "Evil Miasma" began spreading across Mengzhou.



Suoming: It descended with black rain and rolling clouds. It eroded faces and devoured souls.
Suoming: My homeland, Huating, was ravaged by it. Countless lives were lost.
Rover: So it was during that fight your companions were...
Suoming: Yes... They were willing to die for Huating. Still, I hated the Sentinel for never reaching out to help us.
Rover: Back then, Hsin the Moon Fox was heavily weakened and in no state to watch over all of Mengzhou.
Suoming: Exactly. So when I finally met Her, how could I hold onto that hatred?
Suoming: I simply inherited the title of Intendant and purged the remnants of "Balanophora" from our ranks.
Suoming: Together with other Ministry members, we bore Providence Locks created from Fractal Proliferation. They're fragments of the Sentinel's power that allowed us to quell crises across Mengzhou.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: This Providence Lock really came through for me this time as well. Speaking of which, Mengzhou should be stabilizing by now, right?
Suoming: Yes, Arbiter... You needn't worry.
Suoming: Although there is one matter that remains unresolved. You should be made aware.
[Dialogue Option]  Go ahead.
Suoming: Mingting has long coordinated the Ministries of Sentinel Affairs across every city, seeking greater possibilities for the Huanglong Sentinels.
Suoming: Whatever happens, we cannot let our enemies seize the initiative again.
Suoming: Still, as I said, nothing is settled yet. Should there be progress down the line, your involvement will be indispensable.
Rover: I understand. If it concerns the Sentinels, I'll do everything I can.
Suoming: I would share more, but I haven't had the luxury of involving myself in that particular affair.
Rover: That's alright. It's always a comfort to know a little more about the Sentinels... or rather, my partners in all of this.
Rover: Thank you for sharing, Suoming.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: Thank you for sharing, Suoming.



Hsin: Arbiter, look. The celebrations are at their liveliest now. Let's go.
Rover: Mm...
Rover: (I guess Hsin the Moon Fox hasn't witnessed this festival with Its own eyes... not since It was betrayed.)
Rover: (If I'd gotten here sooner, maybe It would still be here—)
Hsin: Is something wrong?
Rover: Nothing. Let's go.
Hsin: Arbiter, if the Sentinel saw someone with a sad face at the festival, It would take their hand and walk with them through the celebration until their smile returned.
Hsin: I wish the Sentinel could see this. Ever since that day, It never came to the Waking Moon Festival again.
Hsin: Hehe, you are more sentimental than I thought. I don't even need my powers of emotional sensing to read you.
Rover: ...
Hsin: I feel sad too.
Rover: You... all of you Sentinels always carry these heavy burdens alone. By the time I arrive, you've already backed yourselves into a corner.
Rover: Once again, I came too late.
Hsin: Arbiter, inside the Vermillion Lock Suoming gave me resides the Sentinel's last strand of frequency.
Rover: Its last frequency? What did It say?
Hsin: The Sentinel... It apologized to me. It said It had put me through so much hardship, and given me no other choice.
Hsin: And then, It told me It approved of my choices. It watched me walk my own path, step by step, and said I walked it better than It could...
Hsin: Arbiter, it was you who opened my eyes. I could not betray the hopes Mengzhou placed in "Hsin."
Hsin: And then, with the Sentinel's... with the approval from the one I admired most, I was able to transform.
Hsin: And Xuanfang Hold and Mengzhou were able to rise again, bathed in such warm, splendorous light.
Rover: Long ago, It chose to build Xuanfang Hold to protect every living soul in this land. Then It created you, to remold the Civilization Capsule in a way never done before.
Rover: Even knowing you might have to choose between the people and the Sentinel... It never wavered.
Hsin: Mm, that is why... It told me It was sorry.
Rover: Yes. It loved Mengzhou that deeply. Every thought, every intention was bound to this land.
Rover: Like you said, Hsin the Moon Fox always cherished the joys of the mortal world. It could never bear to see sorrow.
Rover: If all we do is grieve, we'd be betraying Its very heart.
Hsin: Exactly. So cheer up. The Sentinel never taught me how to console a sorrowful Arbiter.
Rover: Thank you, Hsin. Knowing what the Sentinel said in the end... It really mattered to me.
Hsin: No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
Hsin: Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: No need to thank me. Let us simply take in the lantern lights together.
Hsin: Heavy is the weight you have carried, Arbiter.



Hsin: I need to say it once more. Thank you, Arbiter.
Hsin: If you had not come, I cannot imagine how things would have ended.
Hsin: You were about to say, "No need. This is what an Arbiter should do," weren't you?
[Dialogue Option]  Glad you know it.
[Dialogue Option]  You guessed it.
Rover: Xuanfang Hold's affairs are settled for now. But Mengzhou... how is it faring?
Hsin: Mm... Remember that "lock" that young lady from the Ministry of Sentinel Affairs gave you?
Hsin: The Sentinel's assassination could not be hidden forever. But those above insisted on keeping it secret. If not for good, then for as long as they could.
Hsin: Those below could only feign ignorance.
Rover: ...Suoming?
Hsin: Worry not. That girl is one of ours. She has kept this secret well. If not, "those people" would never have allowed her to represent the Ministry here.
Rover: And what of Mengzhou itself?
Hsin: The Moon Fox's power has always been geared toward defense. Mengzhou retains many of Its protections. The Threnodian's invasion is not an immediate threat.
Hsin: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Hsin: Perhaps, because you repelled Ovathrax in Jinzhou, Mengzhou has remained peaceful.



Hsin: As for the Ministry, that young lady manages it. I'll speak with her soon about other tasks.
Rover: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... Yes, I'll keep an eye on their movements too.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Rover: The Ministry of Sentinel Affairs... Yes, I'll keep an eye on their movements too.



Hsin: Oh, and... I asked the Celestials about those satellites and Court of Savantae lettering. But it was so long ago, even they could not say for certain.
Hsin: ...Perhaps the past Moon Fox knew. But my memory has gaps from the time I arrived in Xuanfang... I will keep searching for you.
Hsin: What I do remember is blurred, but I can send what I have to the Black Shores for analysis. Perhaps they will discover something I overlooked...
Rover: Good, someone from the Black Shores will contact you.
Rover: Rest now. Let your thoughts settle. Tonight, at least, let yourself share this "Waking Moon Festival" with all of Xuanfang.

Girl: Wow, it's Lady Hsin.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Girl: Wow, it's Lady Hsin.



Joyful laughter echoes through the lantern-lit streets, while clear moonlight shines upon the bustling Hold as ever.
A few days later, somewhere in the Land of Xuanfang...

Suoming: Hsin the Moon Fox? It's not time to depart yet, is it?
Hsin: Not yet. Why don't you call me Hsin? Such formality.
Suoming: As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
Hsin: Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.

title: Simulacrum of the Heart
content:
Suoming: As I addressed the Sentinel before, so I will do so today.
Hsin: Hehe, a strange display of care, but I'll accept it. Thank you.



Hsin: I came to thank you for your recent efforts, but... more than that, I came to apologize.
Hsin: You unlocked two Vermillion Locks, didn't you? One to hold the Sentinel's frequency, the other when Suhsin dragged me away.
Hsin: Who exactly... is inside them?
Suoming: The Sixth and Eighth Seals. One sharp-tongued, one taciturn.
Suoming: They are Reverberations that should have faded a century ago, sustained only by my obsession. You owe no apology.
Suoming: At both turns, I knew the task at hand outweighed my own attachments.
Hsin: But Suoming, you are not one with a strong Resonance Ability, yet you've lived through centuries.
Hsin: It was your obsession with the Ten Seals that carried you this far? If one day, you release them all—
Suoming: I would welcome that day, Hsin the Moon Fox.
Hsin: Suoming...
Suoming: Enough about me. Have you chosen who will accompany us to Mengzhou?
Hsin: The Zhaoming Commerce Guild will provide us with cover along the way. Besides that, three more skilled individuals are joining us.
Suoming: A fugitive framed by the Fractsidus, formerly known as the "Blind Watcher."
Suoming: A Jinzhou Patroller who has deep ties to Zhuojun Atelier.
Suoming: And the third... an informant who, having finally seen his vengeance satisfied, offered his blade to our cause.
Hsin: You have met them already?
Suoming: That Chairwoman has her own methods for bringing together those who share a common purpose.
Hsin: Hmph, it seems my grand plans for a "welcome party" for little Suoming were quite unnecessary. Seems I needn't worry about you getting along.
Suoming: We all have scores to settle in Mengzhou. Naturally, the conversation hardly runs dry.
Hsin: Indeed... We all have scores to settle.

title: Mengzhou
content:
Mengzhou is a Province of Huanglong and one of its six major cities. It is renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Here commerce and Taoism thrive and coexist in perfect harmony.

Under the guidance of its Sentinel Hsin, the people of Mengzhou have developed unique automata mechanics which have been deployed in the land of Xuanfang as a bulwark to repel the Tacet Discord threat, especially before the founding of Jinzhou. Mengzhou borders Jinzhou, only separated by Xuanfang, which comes under the jurisdiction of Mengzhou's frontier court.

title: Mengzhou
content: Under the Ministry of War in Mengzhou, the soldiers responsible for guarding Xuanfang Hold are known as Xuanfang Wardens. They act as the military of Xuanfang, assisting Autopuppets in defending the region. The Xuan Triad is a special unit formed by the Xuanfang Wardens, composed of three elite Wardens. Members of this unit are also known as Xuan Watchers. The Xuan Triad is tasked with handling incidents beyond the capabilities of standard Xuanfang Wardens.

title: Mengzhou
content:
A Martial Arts Championship between various sects from Huanglong once took place in a lone mountain peak here, where Buling and Jianxin, as disciples of Master Jiufeng and Master Shiling respectively, fought. After the fight was over, a mysterious white-robed master, carrying a guqin in her arms, confronted Buling about her conceding the fight to Jianxin.

The Court of Savantae was once active in Mengzhou, having assisted Hsin in building Xuanfang Hold on the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War. As the fortress had been built with the partnership of the Zhuojun Atelier, this unexpected choice was seen as snubbing the group according to some of its members.

Xuanfang Hold is a region of the Mengzhou Province in Huanglong, and the primary settlement of the frontier region of Xuanfang. It is located between the cities of Mengzhou and Jinzhou, and is considered a vital passageway between them.

Before the founding of Jinzhou, Xuanfang Hold was established north of the Clouded Cliffs by Sentinel Hsin and Mengzhou's frontier court to contain and divide the Tacet Discord outbreak flowing from Norfall Barrens. It was built atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War in collaboration with the Court of Savantae.

One of its mountains is said to have a reclusive martial arts master living at the peak.
